title: Ask toward an open problem: Yang-Mills existence and mass gap
statement: Propose five candidate un-asked questions, each smaller than the open problem below and each such that its answer would bear on it. Problem OP-PHYS-YM: Does a quantum Yang-Mills theory exist on four-dimensional space-time for every compact simple gauge group, and does it have a mass gap? Each candidate must pass the Depth requirement of LEDGER.md, must not be a duplicate of ledger/INDEX.md, must not be the problem itself or a known reformulation of it, and must carry a bears_on link to OP-PHYS-YM saying how its answer would bear on the problem.
